<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Ali Wael Soliman — AWS Cloud & DevOps Engineer</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --paper:#0B1220;
    --paper-soft:#0F1A2C;
    --panel:#101C31;
    --panel-soft:#152540;
    --ink:#EAF1F8;
    --ink-soft:#B9C8DA;
    --muted:#7C8DA6;
    --line:#22344F;
    --line-strong:#324B6C;
    --teal:#2FD3C7;
    --teal-deep:#1BA69C;
    --amber:#FF9E2C;
    --amber-soft:#FFC27A;
    --radius:6px;
    --maxw:1120px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
    *{animation-duration:.001ms !important; animation-iteration-count:1 !important; transition-duration:.001ms !important;}
  }
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.65;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  a{color:var(--teal);}
  h1,h2,h3{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk', sans-serif;
    font-weight:600;
    margin:0;
    color:var(--ink);
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
  }
  .mono{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;}
  .wrap{max-width:var(--maxw); margin:0 auto; padding:0 32px; position:relative; z-index:1;}
  img{max-width:100%; display:block;}

  /* ---------- animated backdrop: drifting network nodes ---------- */
  #netbg{
    position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0; opacity:.55; pointer-events:none;
  }
  body::before{
    content:"";
    position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0;
    background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%, rgba(47,211,199,.10), transparent 40%),
                       radial-gradient(circle at 85% 75%, rgba(255,158,44,.09), transparent 45%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }

  /* ---------- Nav ---------- */
  header.nav{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(11,18,32,.78);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav-inner{
    max-width:var(--maxw); margin:0 auto; padding:16px 32px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  }
  .nav-mark{
    font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:16px;
    color:var(--ink); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; text-decoration:none;
  }
  .nav-mark .dot{
    width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(47,211,199,.15);
    animation:pulse-dot 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse-dot{
    0%,100%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(47,211,199,.15); }
    50%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(47,211,199,.05); }
  }
  nav.links{display:flex; gap:26px;}
  nav.links a{
    color:var(--ink-soft); text-decoration:none; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500;
    position:relative; padding:4px 0; transition:color .2s ease;
  }
  nav.links a::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; height:1px; width:0%;
    background:var(--teal); transition:width .25s ease;
  }
  nav.links a:hover{color:var(--ink);}
  nav.links a:hover::after{width:100%;}
  .nav-cta{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    padding:8px 16px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; border-radius:var(--radius);
    background:var(--teal); color:#04211E; text-decoration:none; transition:transform .15s ease, background .2s ease;
  }
  .nav-cta:hover{background:var(--amber); transform:translateY(-1px);}
  .navburger{display:none;}

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero{ position:relative; padding:100px 0 84px; overflow:hidden; }
  .hero-grid{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.2fr 0.85fr; gap:56px; align-items:center;
  }
  .eyebrow-line{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; margin-bottom:22px;
    padding:6px 12px 6px 8px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:999px;
    background:rgba(47,211,199,.06);
    opacity:0; animation:rise .7s ease forwards; animation-delay:.05s;
  }
  .eyebrow-line .led{
    width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal);
    box-shadow:0 0 8px 1px rgba(47,211,199,.7);
    animation:blink 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1;}50%{opacity:.35;}}
  .eyebrow-line span{ font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--teal); letter-spacing:.02em;}

  .hero h1{
    font-size:50px; line-height:1.1; margin-bottom:16px;
    opacity:0; animation:rise .7s ease forwards; animation-delay:.15s;
  }
  .hero h1 .grad{
    background:linear-gradient(100deg, var(--teal) 10%, var(--amber-soft) 60%, var(--amber) 90%);
    -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
    background-size:200% auto;
    animation:sheen 5s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes sheen{ to{ background-position:200% center; } }

  .role-line{
    font-size:20px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:22px; min-height:30px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px;
    opacity:0; animation:rise .7s ease forwards; animation-delay:.28s;
  }
  #typed{ color:var(--teal); font-weight:600; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:18px;}
  .caret{ display:inline-block; width:2px; height:19px; background:var(--teal); margin-left:2px; animation:caret-blink 1s steps(1) infinite; }
  @keyframes caret-blink{ 50%{opacity:0;} }

  .hero .usp{
    font-size:15.5px; color:var(--muted); max-width:490px; margin-bottom:30px;
    border-left:2px solid var(--teal); padding-left:16px;
    opacity:0; animation:rise .7s ease forwards; animation-delay:.4s;
  }
  .cta-row{ display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; opacity:0; animation:rise .7s ease forwards; animation-delay:.52s;}
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:13px 24px;
    font-size:14.5px; font-weight:600; border-radius:var(--radius); text-decoration:none;
    border:1px solid transparent; cursor:pointer; font-family:'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif;
    transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, background .2s ease;
  }
  .btn-primary{ background:var(--teal); color:#04211E; box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(47,211,199,.5);}
  .btn-primary:hover{ transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 10px 24px -8px rgba(47,211,199,.55);}
  .btn-ghost{ background:transparent; border-color:var(--line-strong); color:var(--ink);}
  .btn-ghost:hover{ border-color:var(--amber); color:var(--amber-soft); transform:translateY(-2px);}

  @keyframes rise{ from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px);} to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);} }

  .hero-photo-wrap{ position:relative; justify-self:center; opacity:0; animation:rise .8s ease forwards; animation-delay:.3s;}
  .orbit{
    position:absolute; inset:-30px; z-index:-1;
    border:1px dashed rgba(47,211,199,.35); border-radius:50%;
    animation:spin 26s linear infinite;
  }
  .orbit::before, .orbit::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%;
  }
  .orbit::before{ background:var(--amber); top:-4px; left:50%; box-shadow:0 0 10px 2px rgba(255,158,44,.7);}
  .orbit::after{ background:var(--teal); bottom:-4px; right:20%; box-shadow:0 0 10px 2px rgba(47,211,199,.7);}
  @keyframes spin{ to{ transform:rotate(360deg);} }
  .hero-photo{
    width:286px; height:360px; object-fit:cover; display:block;
    border-radius:var(--radius); border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
    background:#16233a;
  }
  .photo-frame{
    position:absolute; top:-14px; left:-14px; width:286px; height:360px;
    border:1px solid var(--teal); border-radius:var(--radius); z-index:-1;
  }
  .photo-tag{
    position:absolute; bottom:-16px; left:-14px; background:var(--panel);
    border:1px solid var(--line-strong); color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; padding:6px 11px; letter-spacing:.03em;
    border-radius:var(--radius); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0;
  }
  .photo-tag .led{
    display:inline-block; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--amber); margin-right:7px; animation:blink 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  /* scroll cue */
  .scroll-cue{ display:flex; justify-content:center; margin-top:56px; opacity:.65;}
  .scroll-cue span{
    width:1px; height:34px; background:linear-gradient(var(--teal), transparent);
    display:block; animation:cue 1.8s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes cue{ 0%{transform:scaleY(0); transform-origin:top;} 50%{transform:scaleY(1); transform-origin:top;} 51%{transform-origin:bottom;} 100%{transform:scaleY(0); transform-origin:bottom;} }

  /* ---------- reveal on scroll ---------- */
  .reveal{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(26px); transition:opacity .7s ease, transform .7s ease; }
  .reveal.in{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); }
  .reveal-stagger > *{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(20px); transition:opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease; }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *{ opacity:1; transform:translateY(0); }
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.02s;}
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.09s;}
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.16s;}
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.23s;}
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(5){transition-delay:.30s;}
  .reveal-stagger.in > *:nth-child(6){transition-delay:.37s;}

  /* ---------- Section shell ---------- */
  section{ padding:88px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--line); position:relative; }
  .sec-head{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:230px 1fr; gap:32px; margin-bottom:44px; }
  .sec-index{ font-size:12.5px; color:var(--teal); letter-spacing:.06em; padding-top:6px;}
  .sec-head h2{ font-size:30px; max-width:640px; }
  @media (max-width:760px){ .sec-head{ grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:10px; } }

  /* ---------- About / stats ---------- */
  .about-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr; gap:48px; align-items:start; }
  .about-text p{ color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:16px; margin:0 0 16px; max-width:60ch; }
  .fact-strip{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:16px; }
  .fact{
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:22px 18px; text-align:center; transition:border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  }
  .fact:hover{ border-color:var(--teal); transform:translateY(-3px); }
  .fact .num{
    display:block; font-family:'Space Grotesk',sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:32px; color:var(--teal);
  }
  .fact .label{ display:block; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:6px; }
  @media (max-width:760px){ .about-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

  /* ---------- Skills ---------- */
  .skill-groups{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:22px; }
  .skill-card{
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius); padding:26px;
    transition:border-color .25s ease, transform .25s ease;
  }
  .skill-card:hover{ border-color:var(--line-strong); transform:translateY(-3px); }
  .skill-card h3{ font-size:16px; margin-bottom:16px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
  .skill-card h3 .idx{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:10.5px; color:#04211E;
    background:var(--teal); padding:3px 7px; border-radius:4px; letter-spacing:.03em;
  }
  .bar-row{ margin-bottom:13px; }
  .bar-row:last-child{ margin-bottom:0; }
  .bar-label{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:6px; }
  .bar-track{ height:6px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--panel-soft); overflow:hidden; }
  .bar-fill{
    height:100%; border-radius:4px; width:0%;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teal), var(--teal-deep));
    transition:width 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.3,1);
  }
  .bar-fill.amber{ background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--amber), #C97114); }
  .chip-row{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; }
  .chip{
    font-size:12.5px; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong);
    color:var(--ink-soft); background:var(--panel-soft); transition:all .2s ease;
  }
  .chip:hover{ border-color:var(--teal); color:var(--ink); transform:translateY(-1px); }
  @media (max-width:760px){ .skill-groups{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

  /* ---------- Timeline (training) ---------- */
  .timeline{ position:relative; padding-left:28px; }
  .timeline::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; left:5px; top:6px; bottom:6px; width:1px;
    background:var(--line-strong); transform-origin:top; transform:scaleY(0);
    transition:transform 1.1s ease;
  }
  .timeline.in::before{ transform:scaleY(1); }
  .tl-item{ position:relative; padding-bottom:38px; }
  .tl-item:last-child{ padding-bottom:0; }
  .tl-item::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; left:-28px; top:5px; width:11px; height:11px; border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--paper); border:2px solid var(--teal);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(47,211,199,.08);
  }
  .tl-item.current::before{ background:var(--teal); animation:pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .tl-date{ font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--teal); letter-spacing:.02em; }
  .tl-item h3{ font-size:17.5px; margin:6px 0 3px; }
  .tl-org{ font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); }
  .tl-item p{ color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14.5px; margin:10px 0 0; max-width:66ch; }

  /* ---------- Projects ---------- */
  .project-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:22px; }
  .project-card{
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius);
    overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column;
    transition:transform .28s ease, border-color .28s ease, box-shadow .28s ease;
  }
  .project-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-6px); border-color:var(--teal);
    box-shadow:0 18px 40px -18px rgba(47,211,199,.35);
  }
  .project-card.flagship{ grid-column:1 / -1; display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr; }
  .project-media{
    position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/10; background:var(--panel-soft); overflow:hidden;
  }
  .project-card.flagship .project-media{ aspect-ratio:auto; height:100%; min-height:260px; }
  .project-media img{ width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .5s ease; }
  .project-card:hover .project-media img{ transform:scale(1.05); }
  .photo-slot{
    width:100%; height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    gap:8px; border:1px dashed var(--line-strong); color:var(--muted); font-size:12px; text-align:center; padding:20px;
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.02) 0 10px, transparent 10px 20px);
  }
  .photo-slot svg{ opacity:.55; }
  .project-body{ padding:24px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; flex:1; }
  .project-tagrow{ display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .tag{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:10.5px; letter-spacing:.02em; padding:3px 8px;
    border-radius:4px; background:rgba(255,158,44,.1); color:var(--amber-soft); border:1px solid rgba(255,158,44,.25);
  }
  .project-body h3{ font-size:18px; }
  .project-body p{ color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:14px; margin:0; flex:1; }
  .stack{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:7px; margin-top:4px; }
  .project-link{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:var(--teal);
    text-decoration:none; margin-top:6px;
  }
  .project-link svg{ transition:transform .2s ease; }
  .project-link:hover svg{ transform:translate(3px,-3px); }
  @media (max-width:820px){
    .project-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .project-card.flagship{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  }

  /* ---------- Services ---------- */
  .service-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:18px; }
  .service-card{
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:24px 20px; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
    transition:transform .25s ease, border-color .25s ease;
  }
  .service-card:hover{ transform:translateY(-5px); border-color:var(--amber); }
  .service-card .p-mark{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:26px; font-weight:600; color:var(--line-strong);
    margin-bottom:14px; transition:color .25s ease;
  }
  .service-card:hover .p-mark{ color:var(--amber); }
  .service-card h3{ font-size:15.5px; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .service-card p{ font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 12px; }
  @media (max-width:900px){ .service-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; } }
  @media (max-width:560px){ .service-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

  /* ---------- Education ---------- */
  .edu-card{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; gap:20px; flex-wrap:wrap;
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius); padding:24px 26px;
  }
  .edu-card .school{ color:var(--muted); font-size:13.5px; display:block; margin-top:4px; }
  .edu-card .gpa{ font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--teal); text-align:right; }
  .cert-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:14px; margin-top:20px; }
  .cert{
    background:var(--panel-soft); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:16px 18px; font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); transition:border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  }
  .cert:hover{ border-color:var(--teal); transform:translateY(-2px); }
  .cert b{ color:var(--ink); display:block; font-size:13.5px; margin-bottom:3px; }
  a.cert{ display:block; text-decoration:none; color:var(--ink-soft); cursor:pointer; }
  a.cert:hover b{ color:var(--teal); }
  @media (max-width:760px){ .cert-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; } }
  @media (max-width:480px){ .cert-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }

  /* ---------- Contact ---------- */
  .contact-panel{
    background:linear-gradient(160deg, #0E2A2A, #0B1220 55%); padding:78px 0 56px; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  }
  .contact-panel::before{
    content:""; position:absolute; inset:0;
    background-image:radial-gradient(circle at 80% 10%, rgba(47,211,199,.16), transparent 45%);
    animation:drift 9s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
  }
  @keyframes drift{ from{ transform:translate(0,0);} to{ transform:translate(-30px,20px);} }
  .contact-panel h2{ font-size:32px; max-width:600px; }
  .lead{ color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:16px; max-width:560px; margin:14px 0; }
  .avail-badge{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; margin-bottom:20px; padding:7px 14px;
    border:1px solid rgba(47,211,199,.4); border-radius:999px; background:rgba(47,211,199,.08);
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--teal);
  }
  .avail-badge .led{ width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%; background:var(--teal); animation:blink 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; box-shadow:0 0 8px 1px rgba(47,211,199,.7);}
  .contact-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:18px; margin-top:38px; }
  .contact-item{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.03); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:18px; transition:border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  }
  .contact-item:hover{ border-color:var(--teal); transform:translateY(-3px); }
  .contact-item .label{ display:block; font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:10.5px; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:.05em; margin-bottom:6px; }
  .contact-item a{ color:var(--ink); font-size:14px; text-decoration:none; font-weight:500; }
  .contact-item a:hover{ color:var(--teal); }
  @media (max-width:820px){ .contact-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; } }
  @media (max-width:480px){ .contact-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; } }
  .foot{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin-top:52px; padding-top:22px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--line); font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--muted);
  }

  /* ---------- back to top ---------- */
  #toTop{
    position:fixed; bottom:24px; right:24px; z-index:40; width:42px; height:42px; border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line-strong); color:var(--teal);
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; cursor:pointer;
    opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .25s ease, transform .2s ease;
  }
  #toTop.show{ opacity:1; pointer-events:auto; }
  #toTop:hover{ transform:translateY(-3px); border-color:var(--teal); }

  @media (max-width:900px){
    .hero-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr; }
    .hero-photo-wrap{ order:-1; margin-bottom:10px; }
    nav.links{ display:none; }
    .hero h1{ font-size:38px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
